# Turno

The actions your AI can run on Turno through DozalDevs. They are the same tools a Dozal uses, run the same way. Run one with `run_app_action` (MCP) or the run-app-action command, app `turno` and the action's slug below; `get_app_action` shows its inputs. A Viewer key runs only the actions that read.

| Action                       | Reads or changes      | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ---------------------------- | --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `ADD_PROPERTY_CONTRACTOR`    | changes               | Link a contractor to a property, with optional assignment settings                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `CANCEL_ASSIGNMENT`          | changes (cancel)      | Cancel an assignment (remove a cleaner from a project) in Turno                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `CREATE_ASSIGNMENT`          | changes               | Assign a cleaner to a project in Turno (irreversible, billable)                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `CREATE_BLOCKED_DATE`        | changes               | Create a blocked date for a Turno property. GOTCHA: body fields are start_date/end_date, never from/to.                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `CREATE_BOOKING`             | changes               | Create a new booking (guest reservation) for a Turno property                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `CREATE_PROBLEM`             | changes               | Create a new problem report for a property                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `CREATE_PROJECT`             | changes               | Create a new project (cleaning job) for a Turno property                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `CREATE_PROPERTY`            | changes               | Create a new property connection in Turno                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `DELETE_BLOCKED_DATE`        | changes (delete data) | Delete a blocked date. IRREVERSIBLE: permanently removes the record and the dates become bookable again immediately.                                                                                                                                                     |
| `DELETE_BOOKING`             | changes (delete data) | Delete a booking. ⚠️ IRREVERSIBLE: permanently removes the reservation record from Turno.                                                                                                                                                                                |

IRREVERSIBLE: permanently removes the checklist records.                                                                                                                                                                   |

| `UPDATE_PROJECT`             | changes               | Update an existing Turno project (partial update — only supplied fields change)                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `UPDATE_PROPERTY`            | changes               | Update an existing Turno property (partial update)                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `UPDATE_PROPERTY_CONTRACTOR` | changes               | Update a contractor's link settings for a property (partial update)                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

## Notes

Written for Dozals, so an action is named by its slug in lowercase with dashes (`add-property-contractor` is `ADD_PROPERTY_CONTRACTOR`), and `--name` is the input `name`.

### Reading

- Most list tools follow every page for you: `list-properties` (20 a page), `list-bookings`, `list-problems`, `list-blocked-dates`, `list-reviews`, `list-webhooks`. `list-projects` returns one page, so pass `--page` for the next one.
- To list cleaning jobs for a window, use `list-projects --start` and `--end`, plus `--properties`, `--cleaners` or `--customers` to narrow. `--none` shows jobs with no cleaner assigned.
- `list-problems` needs `--property-id`, and takes `--status solved` or `unresolved`.
- `list-bookings` filters by check-in and check-out ranges and takes `--properties` as a JSON array of numbers, such as `[1,2]`.
- To find one contractor, filter the `list-contractors` result yourself. There's no lookup by id.

### Changing things

- Blocked dates need `--start-date` and `--end-date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`), an `--external-blocked-date-id` of your own, and a `--summary`.
- `create-project` is a cleaning job. It needs `--property-id`, `--begin-time`, `--end-time`, `--project-type-id` (see `list-project-types`), `--charge-type` (`FLAT` or `HOURLY`) and `--cleaning-price`. `--publish` makes it visible at once.
- `create-assignment` puts a cleaner on a job. It can't be undone and it bills. Check the project and contractor ids first.
- The `update-*` tools change only the fields you give.
- These can't be undone: `delete-booking`, `delete-project`, `delete-blocked-date`, `delete-property-checklist`, `delete-webhook`, `remove-property-contractor` and `disconnect-property`. Some may wait for the owner's approval. Use them only when the job says to.
- `notify-early-checkout` tells Turno a guest left early. Pass the project id with `--id`.

### When it fails

- A 404 means that id doesn't exist. Check the id. Any other error carries only the status, so report it with what you were doing. A 401 means the saved token or Partner ID was rejected; report it and stop.
